structure_basis: Registered tables and declarations observed in the cited local GeoPackage(s); not proof of every valid variant.
identifier_basis: Whole-column observations in the cited VPUs, not an exhaustive vocabulary or a normative validation rule.

routing.note: Observed v2.2 convention, not an exhaustive specification. See docs/consistency-checks/data-model-v2.2.md.

numeric_value_policy.scope: numeric operand columns of these rules, independent of row applicability
numeric_value_policy.note: SQLite may expose NaN as NULL; when indistinguishable, apply the undetermined NULL policy.

sentinel_handling.scope: all numeric-declared Data Model columns, independent of row applicability

attribute_constraints.note: These are CAM-1602 requested validation assumptions, not universal physical laws or guarantees that published data satisfy them. Sentinel meaning and NULL handling remain undetermined without field-specific definitions.
